name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 1 – Am 43
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 1q. Recalls the report of the UN Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territories occupied since 1967, Francesca Albanese, entitled ‘From Economy of Occupation to Economy of Genocide’, presented at the 59th session of the UN Human Rights Council; urges the Commission and the Member States to take the measures necessary to impose targeted economic sanctions against those companies identified in the aforementioned report as contributing to sustaining the economy of the unfolding genocide in Gaza;
